_note: Paraphrased CBAM supplier-readiness checklist written for this project. Not the legal text. Based on the structure of Regulation (EU) 2023/956, its implementing rules, and ISO 14064-1 style GHG inventory practice. Verify against official EU guidance before real use.

items.requirement: Installation is uniquely identified: legal name, address, geo-coordinates, operator contact.
items.evidence_expected: Company profile or monitoring plan cover page

items.requirement: Each product exported to the EU is mapped to its CN code and CBAM goods category.
Production processes and their boundaries are defined, with every emission source and source stream assigned to a process.
items.evidence_expected: Process flow diagram and source-stream list

items.requirement: The production route for each product is stated (e.g. EAF from scrap, induction furnace, re-rolling of purchased billets).
items.evidence_expected: Monitoring plan section on production routes

items.requirement: A documented monitoring methodology exists describing how activity data and factors are obtained for each source stream.
Fuel consumption is recorded per process from metered or invoiced data for the full reporting period.
Carbon-containing inputs (electrodes, coal, carbon additives) are recorded with quantities and carbon content.
items.evidence_expected: Store issue records, lab or supplier carbon analysis

items.requirement: Electricity consumption is recorded per process, separating grid and on-site generation.
Production output per product is recorded for the same period as emissions data.
Emission factors and net calorific values are documented with their source (default or measured) and justification.
The electricity emission factor used is documented with its source and basis.
All meters used for activity data are listed, calibrated within interval, and traceable.
Measurement uncertainty of key activity data is estimated.
Purchased precursors (e.g. billets) are identified by supplier, quantity and route.
Actual embedded emissions data is obtained from each precursor supplier, or the use of default values is documented.
Any carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin is documented with evidence.
items.evidence_expected: Tax or ETS payment records, or a statement of none

items.requirement: Data flow, control activities, and responsibilities are documented, including how gaps are filled.
Records are retained for the required period and are retrievable for verification.
The installation has planned verification of its emissions data by an accredited verifier before EU customers' declaration deadline.
Specific embedded emissions per product are reported to EU importers in a structured format.
items.evidence_expected: Completed emissions communication to EU buyer
